Khursheed Anwar vs Sunil Kumar Gupta on 5 December, 2025

IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NO.13774 OF 2025

KHURSHEED ANWAR & ANR.                                    APPELLANT(S)
                       VERSUS
SUNIL KUMAR GUPTA
RP OF CYGNUS SPLENDID LTD. & ORS.                         RESPONDENT(S)

ORDER

1. We find no good reason to interfere with the impugned order dated 19.09.2025 passed by the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal, Principal Bench, New Delhi in Company Appeal (AT)(Insolvency) No. 1464 of 2025.

2. The appeal is accordingly dismissed.

3. Pending application(s), if any, stands disposed of.

[J.B. PARDIWALA], J.
[PRASANNA B. VARALE], J.

New Delhi
5th December, 2025.
